$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{′}(t)=2{x}_{1}(t)+3{x}_{2}(t)+4\operatorname{sin}⁡(2t)-5\operatorname{cos}⁡(3t) \\ {x}_{2}^{′}(t)=-{x}_{1}(t)+{x}_{2}(t)+2\operatorname{sin}⁡(2t)+3\operatorname{cos}⁡(3t)\end{aligned}
$$

The systems of linear ODEs above can be written in matrix form as follows:

| ${x}^{′}(t)=\,\,$ |  | {{field-1}} | {{field-2}} |  | $\,\,x(t)+\,\,$ |  | {{field-3}} |  |  | $\,\operatorname{sin}⁡(2t)+\,\,$ |  | {{field-4}} |  | $\,\operatorname{cos}⁡(3t)$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

question.worked_solution:
First, let's rewrite our system, highlighting the coefficients:

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{′}(t)=2\cdot {x}_{1}(t)+3\cdot {x}_{2}(t)+4\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡(2t)+(-5)\cdot \operatorname{cos}⁡(3t) \\ {x}_{2}^{′}(t)=(-1)\cdot {x}_{1}(t)+1\cdot {x}_{2}(t)+2\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡(2t)+3\cdot \operatorname{cos}⁡(3t)\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in matrix form:

$$
{x}^{′}(t)=[\begin{aligned}2 & 3 \\ -1 & 1\end{aligned}]x(t)+[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 2\end{aligned}]\operatorname{sin}⁡(2t)+[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 3\end{aligned}]\operatorname{cos}⁡(3t)
$$

where $x(t)=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}(t) \\ {x}_{2}(t)\end{aligned}].$
